title: As the Deer Pants for Water
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a weary Israelite worshipper stands beside a dry streambed in a mountainous region, searching for a small remaining pool of water among the stones. His face is tired, and his gaze turns toward the distant hills as he longs for the living God. In the background, deer move cautiously along the watercourse, evoking the psalm's opening image without making the animals the main subject. A group of travelers approaches a distant sanctuary road, while the worshipper remains separated from them by the rugged terrain and the distance of his journey. His hand rests against a rock as he remembers earlier days when he went with a joyful crowd to the house of God, accompanied by songs of praise. The image should convey spiritual longing, tears, and homesickness for worship. The sky is overcast, but a break in the clouds illuminates the far hills, suggesting the possibility of renewed hope. Keep the emotional expression honest and restrained rather than hopeless. Accurate ancient Near Eastern landscape, realistic deer, simple robes, natural light, and detailed stone textures. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Deep Calls to Deep: Hope in God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite traveler stands near a powerful mountain stream that descends through a narrow rocky gorge. Water pours over stones and gathers in a deep pool, representing the overwhelming waves and billows described in the psalm. The traveler is safe on the bank, soaked by spray but not in danger, and he looks upward while remembering God's steadfast love by day and the song and prayer that sustain him by night. Far behind him, distant ridges and mist evoke separation from home and sanctuary. His shoulders are heavy, and he appears to be wrestling with repeated inner questions about why his soul is cast down and troubled. Yet he lifts his head toward the horizon, renewing the decision to hope in God, his salvation and his God. The landscape should communicate the scale of sorrow without suggesting that water itself is a literal divine force. Use realistic river movement, wet stones, sparse mountain vegetation, historically plausible travel garments, and natural overcast light. No modern bridges, equipment, captions, or fantasy imagery.

title: Send Out Your Light and Your Truth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the same Israelite worshipper from the preceding scenes stands at the entrance to a narrow mountain path leading toward Jerusalem and its sanctuary. He raises his face in prayer, asking God to judge his cause, defend him against deceitful oppression, and send out His light and truth to lead him. In the foreground, the road divides around jagged stones: one branch descends into a shaded gorge, while the other winds upward toward a distant city glowing in the first light of morning. The worshipper begins moving along the brighter path, not because every problem has already disappeared but because he is choosing to follow the guidance he seeks from God. A small group of fellow travelers waits farther up the road, suggesting hope for renewed fellowship in worship. Do not depict divine light as a visible magical beam or add a literal angel as a guide. Use realistic ancient terrain, woven travel cloaks, leather sandals, stone paths, and soft natural sunrise. The scene should conclude the two-psalm emotional movement from longing and discouragement toward hope and the expectation of praising God again. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: We Have Heard What God Did for Our Ancestors
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a gathering of ancient Israelites listens as an elder recounts the nation's history beside a fortified settlement. The elder gestures toward the surrounding hills and fertile valleys, recalling how earlier generations heard of God's works and how the people received their inheritance not by their own sword or strength alone, but through divine help and favor. Behind him, a younger generation watches attentively, while a few farmers and shepherds stand near the city gate. David or a representative worshipper listens with sober gratitude, recognizing that the community's past deliverance belongs to God's power. Show a broad landscape with cultivated fields, rocky ridges, and a distant valley where ancestral settlement might have taken place. Avoid reconstructing a specific battle or depicting an identifiable conquest beyond what the psalm itself describes. The emphasis is on communal memory, inherited faith, and trust in God as King. Historically grounded clothing, ancient tools, stone architecture, and warm daylight. No modern maps, printed books, national flags, or fantasy effects.

title: The People Feel Abandoned and Shamed
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite settlement after a military setback. The gates remain standing, but the people are demoralized and the fields outside show signs of disruption. Families gather possessions, a few livestock are being led away along a dusty road, and elderly residents look toward the hills with worried expressions. There is no graphic violence and no corpses. In the foreground, an Israelite worshipper holds a plain shield lowered at his side, conveying confusion about why the community has suffered defeat despite trusting God. Another person covers his face in grief while a companion offers quiet support. The distant road disappears toward foreign territory, reflecting the psalm's language of being scattered, becoming a reproach to neighbors, and enduring mockery. The scene must feel like a lament addressed to God rather than a claim that the people have ceased believing in Him. Use historically plausible homes, storage jars, simple shields, wool garments, and subdued natural light. No modern military equipment, text, graphic injury, or fantasy effects.

title: Awake, O LORD: Redeem Us for Your Mercy's Sake
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelite elders, parents, and younger worshippers gathers in the courtyard of a damaged but inhabited settlement. They sit together in solemn prayer, asking why defeat has come even though they remember the covenant and have not consciously abandoned the LORD. A senior man holds an old, carefully preserved scroll that symbolizes the people's inherited testimony, while a mother comforts a child beside a clay water jar. The composition should not imply that every individual is innocent of all wrongdoing; it depicts the community's heartfelt protest that it has not deliberately forgotten God or turned aside from the path of faith. Several people lower their heads, expressing humility as they plead for help because of God's steadfast love rather than their own power. Beyond the courtyard, a rough road leads toward distant hills beneath a darkening sky. The scene conveys distress and the urgent cry for divine intervention, not despair without prayer. Authentic ancient clothing, stone walls, woven mats, realistic expressions, and restrained light. No modern objects, written slogans, graphic violence, or fantasy imagery.

title: A Royal Song for the King
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite royal court prepared for a ceremonial occasion. A court poet sits at a low writing table with a parchment scroll and reed pen, pausing as inspiration fills him with enthusiasm for composing a song concerning the king. Nearby, the king stands before trusted attendants, wearing a finely woven royal robe, a simple crown, and a belt decorated with carefully crafted details appropriate to the ancient Near East. His bearing communicates dignity, justice, and gracious speech rather than vanity. A row of guards and mounted messengers waits near the city gate, suggesting the royal strength described in the song. The background includes the stone walls of Jerusalem, decorated doorways, and attendants arranging garments and gifts. This is a royal poetic portrayal, not a claim that every phrase describes a specific military campaign. The image should evoke truth, humility, righteousness, and the king's cause without excessive violence. Historically plausible royal textiles, leather, woodwork, and natural morning light. No European medieval crowns, modern uniforms, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: The Throne Established in Righteousness
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a dignified Israelite royal throne room with stone pillars, carved wooden doors, and woven curtains. The king sits upon a raised throne, clothed in fine fabrics and wearing a simple gold crown. His expression is serious and fair, emphasizing a royal ideal of righteousness, justice, and hatred of wickedness. Around him, attendants hold vessels of fragrant oil and display finely woven garments, while musicians prepare for a formal celebration. A queen or royal consort stands near the king in elegant but historically plausible clothing, accompanied by attendants who arrange jewelry and a richly embroidered mantle. The court's materials should appear precious without becoming fantastical: gold inlays, ivory-like ornamentation where historically appropriate, and polished wood, all restrained. The scene conveys the psalm's language of anointed kingship, fragrant garments, music, and royal honor. Do not depict the throne as God Himself or assume that the poetic text is a straightforward record of one specific ceremony. Authentic ancient Near Eastern royal clothing, realistic architecture, lamplight and soft daylight. No modern furniture, legible inscriptions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Royal Bride and the Joyful Procession
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient royal wedding procession moving slowly through a courtyard in Jerusalem. The bride wears an elegant woven garment with modest jewelry and a finely arranged veil or head covering consistent with ancient Near Eastern fashion. Her attendants walk nearby carrying small vessels and beautifully folded fabrics. The king waits at the entrance to the royal hall, dressed in ceremonial robes, as musicians prepare a joyful song. Members of both households gather respectfully, and elders watch the procession with approving expressions. The bride looks toward the king with a mixture of solemnity and expectation, while her companions support her as she approaches the new household. Decorated doorways, embroidered textiles, gold ornaments, and oil lamps provide richness without modern luxury. The image should communicate the psalm's courtly poetry about leaving the former household, receiving royal honor, and being remembered among future generations. Avoid presenting the scene as a documented marriage of a named historical king when the text does not specify one. No modern wedding dresses, glass chandeliers, printed signs, or fantasy effects.

title: God Is Our Refuge and Strength
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with a dramatic but grounded landscape. An ancient Israelite city stands beside a river beneath steep mountains, with strong stone walls and closely gathered homes. Beyond the city, the earth appears unsettled: distant mountains loom beneath heavy clouds, and the river runs high among the rocks. Inside the city, families gather calmly in a sheltered courtyard while worshippers pray and an elder reassures children that God is their refuge and strength. The waterway passes near the settlement but does not sweep people away. In the center of the composition, a steady stream flows through the city, symbolizing the river that makes glad the city of God and the holy place where the Most High dwells. The natural storm represents the psalm's poetic image of the earth changing and waters roaring; it should not be a literal apocalyptic disaster. Use realistic stone architecture, flowing water, ancient clothing, natural weather, and a contrast between storm clouds and a small area of morning light. No modern dams, skyscrapers, or fantasy effects.

title: Be Still and Know That I Am God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the fortified city from the preceding scene remains secure as the landscape outside transitions from turmoil to quiet. In the distance, abandoned war carts and lowered banners suggest that conflict among nations has ceased, with no visible casualties or graphic battle. Inside the city, an Israelite family stands near a window looking out at the calmer valley, while worshippers gather in a simple courtyard. A respected elder raises one hand gently, inviting the people to be still and recognize God's sovereignty over the nations and the earth. The scene should express God's presence as a refuge and His ability to bring conflicts to an end, without depicting God as a visible human figure or claiming that a particular historical war is being shown. A quiet stream reflects the first clear light after the storm, and the city gate stands open without threat. Use realistic ancient architecture, woven robes, stone paving, natural light, and quiet human expressions. No modern weapons, national flags, written captions, or supernatural spectacle.

title: Clap Your Hands, All Peoples
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a lively but reverent gathering of Israelites in an open public courtyard overlooking a hilltop settlement. Men, women, and children clap their hands and sing together while musicians play lyres, hand drums, and simple wind instruments appropriate to the ancient Near East. David stands among the congregation, encouraging praise to the LORD as the great King over all the earth. The people show joy and awe rather than performative spectacle. In the background, travelers from neighboring regions watch the gathering, suggesting the universal scope of God's kingship. A stone platform and a modest royal standard without readable markings provide a focal point for the community's celebration. The setting should be ancient Israelite, with limestone walls, woven awnings, olive trees, and terraced hills. The scene expresses the psalm's call for all peoples to praise God and its acknowledgment that He governs the nations and gives His people an inheritance. Do not portray God as a human king physically standing in the crowd. No modern instruments, sound systems, flags, text, or fantasy effects.

title: God Has Gone Up with a Shout of Praise
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite procession winds toward a sanctuary on a raised hill. Worshippers sing loudly and musicians accompany them with lyres and hand drums. The people raise their hands and faces in praise as they celebrate God as King over all the earth. The phrase describing God going up is represented by the procession moving uphill toward the sanctuary and by the rising sound of communal praise, not by depicting God as a physically visible person climbing stairs. Visitors from different regions stand among the gathered families, listening and joining the celebration. A group of elders sits near the entrance, observing the procession with solemn joy. Above them, the sky is broad and bright, emphasizing universal sovereignty rather than a local deity confined to one city. Historically plausible Israelite garments, stone steps, fabric canopies, and musical instruments. The atmosphere should be joyful, organized, and deeply reverent. No modern buildings, printed text, electric lights, or fantasy effects.

title: Beautiful in Elevation: The City of the Great King
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a panoramic view of ancient Jerusalem rising on its hills, with stone walls, gates, narrow streets, and the sanctuary visible above surrounding houses. Worshippers stand on a neighboring ridge looking toward the city with admiration, reflecting its beauty as the city of the great King. The city appears secure within its landscape, but not unrealistically enormous or glittering. In the distance, a group of foreign rulers and their attendants approaches along a road, inspecting the fortifications with expressions that shift from confidence to uncertainty. Several chariots stand at a respectful distance while messengers confer near the entrance. The scene evokes the psalm's poetic account of kings gathering, seeing the city, and being overcome by alarm. Do not depict a specific siege or imply that the image documents a named military event. Show ancient Levantine architecture, natural terrain, historically grounded chariots and clothing, and clear mountain light. No modern city skyline, modern weapons, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Walk Around Zion and Tell the Next Generation
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelite elders and young families walks along the walls and towers of ancient Jerusalem. The elders pause to point out the gates, towers, and strong stone fortifications, teaching the younger generation about the city's history and the LORD's enduring protection. In a nearby courtyard, worshippers gather for thanksgiving, their faces reflecting gratitude for God's righteousness and steadfast love. The view from the wall looks outward toward the hills and roads leading to distant settlements, suggesting that the LORD's praise extends to the ends of the earth. A young child holds an elder's hand while looking up at the city's tall towers, absorbing the story that will be passed to future generations. The scene must present the architecture realistically rather than as an invulnerable fantasy fortress. Use ancient limestone construction, timber gates, simple Israelite garments, olive trees, and natural sunlight. The emotional tone is communal memory, reassurance, and intergenerational teaching. No modern city structures, signs, tourist equipment, or fantasy effects.

title: Hear This, All Peoples: Wealth Cannot Redeem a Life
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public gathering in an ancient Israelite town where people from different social positions sit together to hear a wise teacher. Wealthy merchants wear finer robes and carry small pouches of coins, while farmers, laborers, and families wear simpler garments. The teacher speaks with calm seriousness, explaining that wisdom must be heard by all peoples and that no one can purchase freedom from death with wealth alone. On one side, a rich man opens a chest of precious goods as if demonstrating his status; on the other, an elderly man sits quietly, listening with humility. Between them, a family places a hand on the shoulder of an older relative, reminding viewers of the limits shared by every generation. Do not portray money or prosperity as inherently evil; the point is that material wealth cannot ransom another person's life from mortality. Use historically plausible coinage, storage chests, woven clothing, stone architecture, and natural daylight. No modern currency, printed books, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Wise and the Foolish Share the Grave
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient burial ground on the outskirts of an Israelite town. Several families stand quietly near simple stone-marked graves, including relatives of both prosperous and modest households. The clothing of the mourners varies in quality, but their expressions share the same human grief, visually conveying that wise and foolish, rich and poor all face mortality. In the distance, a once-impressive estate stands beyond cultivated fields, while a small modest home remains occupied nearby. The contrast should show that accumulated possessions cannot follow a person beyond death and that buildings or titles do not defeat the grave. David stands beside an older worshipper, speaking with solemn confidence about the hope that God will redeem the faithful from the power of the grave and receive them. Do not portray a visible underworld, corpses, or graphic funerary detail. Keep the burial scene dignified, simple, and historically plausible, with limestone markers, woven mourning garments, olive trees, and subdued natural light. No modern tombstones, flowers arranged in contemporary fashion, readable inscriptions, or fantasy imagery.

title: Do Not Fear When Someone Becomes Rich
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a marketplace in an ancient Israelite settlement where a wealthy landholder arrives with attendants and fine goods. People turn to look at his possessions and elaborate clothing, and one young man appears impressed by the display. Nearby, a wise elder gently advises the young man not to be afraid or envious when another person grows rich, because honor and possessions cannot be carried into the grave. A quiet family scene in the background shows ordinary life continuing without display: parents share bread with children while a neighbor helps carry water from a well. David listens to the elder and looks toward the surrounding hills, conveying the psalm's sober view that worldly splendor is temporary if it is not joined to understanding. The rich landholder need not be portrayed as wicked; the point is that wealth is not lasting salvation. Use authentic ancient market goods, woven fabrics, clay jars, modest jewelry, and realistic architecture. The mood is thoughtful rather than resentful. No modern luxury objects, money, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The Mighty God Calls the Earth to Hear
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with grand, poetic landscape imagery. A broad mountain rises above an ancient Israelite valley, with Zion in the distance and the sunrise illuminating the surrounding land. Worshippers gather on an open hillside, their attention directed toward the mountain and sky as a solemn summons goes out to the earth from sunrise to sunset. Dark clouds and a line of fire-like sunlight along the horizon evoke the psalm's imagery of God shining forth and arriving amid consuming fire and tempest, but no literal human-shaped deity appears in the clouds. The landscape should communicate majesty, holiness, and the universal scope of the divine summons. In the foreground, elders and ordinary people stand together, understanding that heaven and earth are called as witnesses while God judges His people. Their expressions are serious and attentive, not terrified of a monster or spectacle. Ancient garments, realistic mountain terrain, natural storm light, and historically plausible settlement details. No modern microphones, written proclamations, or fantasy creatures.

title: The LORD Owns Every Beast and Calls for Thanksgiving
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worship courtyard where people have brought animals and produce for customary offerings. A priest and several worshippers stand near an altar area, but the visual focus is on their hearts and understanding rather than the number of animals present. Beyond the courtyard, open hills are alive with sheep, goats, cattle, birds, and other creatures, illustrating that every animal and the whole world already belong to the LORD. A worshipper begins to pray sincerely and give thanks instead of assuming that God needs to be supplied with food by human hands. Another person brings a small offering with humility and makes a practical effort to help a neighbor in need. David or a representative worshipper stands nearby, encouraging people to call upon God in the day of trouble and fulfill vows with gratitude. The scene must be historically respectful of Israelite sacrifice without depicting a modern church service or suggesting that offerings are meaningless; the psalm warns against treating God as dependent on them. Realistic animals, stone altar architecture, woven garments, and natural light. No modern objects, graphic sacrifice, text, or fantasy effects.

title: God Rebukes Hypocrisy and Hidden Wrongdoing
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public courtyard in an ancient Israelite town where a respected man who speaks piously is confronted by the inconsistency of his conduct. He carries a scroll and speaks confidently about rules, yet a sequence of visible everyday actions reveals the contradiction: he walks away from a family in distress, joins a dishonest transaction, and exchanges knowing glances with someone who spreads harmful rumors about a neighbor. An elder listens to a complaint and looks directly at the hypocritical man, who becomes uncomfortable as his conduct is exposed. The scene should convey God's rebuke of those who recite His instruction while hating correction, participating in theft or adultery, and using speech to deceive or harm relatives. Do not portray an actual named historical offender or make an accusation about a particular person. Use historically grounded Israelite clothing, stone streets, scroll materials, woven baskets, and realistic facial expressions. The atmosphere is solemn and morally serious, not sensational. No modern legal symbols, readable text, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: Offer Thanksgiving and Order Your Way Aright
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worshipper stands near the sanctuary entrance after hearing a solemn warning about forgetting God. He places a modest offering of grain on a clean table and bows his head in thanksgiving, showing that true worship includes gratitude and a life ordered according to God's way. Nearby, he reconciles with a neighbor whose property he had previously neglected, returning a borrowed tool and speaking honestly. A priest or elder observes the reconciliation with quiet approval. The sanctuary courtyard remains dignified and simple, surrounded by limestone walls, woven curtains, oil lamps, and clay vessels. In the distance, an open road leads away from the settlement, suggesting the choice between continued wrongdoing and a path of faithful conduct. The image should communicate the psalm's closing distinction between those who forget God and those who offer thanksgiving and rightly order their ways. Avoid implying that a single gesture automatically guarantees salvation or depicting judgment as a visible supernatural event. Historically plausible garments and natural light. No modern objects, printed captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Have Mercy on Me, O God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, King David sits alone in a quiet stone chamber in ancient Jerusalem, without royal attendants or ceremonial clothing. He wears a simple tunic, and his crown and outer mantle rest on a low wooden chest beside the wall. His posture is humble and heavy with remorse as he pleads for mercy, asking God to blot out his transgressions and cleanse him from sin. An oil lamp burns near an unrolled parchment, but no readable writing is visible. The chamber's simplicity separates the moment from public kingship and emphasizes his personal accountability before God. Through a narrow opening, early light falls on the stone floor, suggesting that truth in the inward parts requires honest acknowledgment rather than outward appearance. The scene relates to the psalm's superscription associating it with David's sin and Nathan's rebuke, but does not depict Bathsheba or invent details beyond the text's focus. Show repentance, humility, and longing for cleansing without graphic details or self-punishment. Authentic ancient Israelite architecture and clothing, restrained lighting, realistic expression. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Create in Me a Clean Heart
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with modest symbolic imagery, David kneels beside a stone basin in the courtyard of his home. He looks toward the open sky while praying for cleansing, a clean heart, and a renewed steadfast spirit. Water runs gently over his hands, representing spiritual cleansing symbolically rather than suggesting that physical washing removes moral guilt. His royal garments remain folded away, and he wears simple clothing appropriate for a private moment of repentance. A small clay lamp and a fresh cloth rest beside the basin, while sunlight gradually illuminates the courtyard. The image should evoke David's desire for restored joy, a willing spirit, and the continued presence of God, while avoiding any literal depiction of God physically removing an invisible stain. His expression is sorrowful yet hopeful, communicating that correction need not be the end of fellowship. A quiet fig tree grows beside the wall, its new leaves catching the light. Historically plausible water vessels, stonework, woven cloth, and natural light. No modern sinks, soap packaging, text, or supernatural effects.

title: A Broken and Contrite Heart
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands before a small group of Israelites in a quiet courtyard, not as a triumphant monarch but as a repentant man ready to speak honestly about God's ways. His hands are open, and his expression conveys humility as he describes his desire to teach transgressors and praise God's righteousness. Nearby, a musician holds a lyre but waits respectfully, showing that songs and offerings are meaningful when joined with sincere devotion. On a low table, a simple offering vessel and a folded cloth symbolize worship, while David kneels briefly in prayer, acknowledging that God does not delight in outward sacrifice detached from a broken and contrite heart. In the background, workers repair a section of Jerusalem's stone wall, a visual reference to the prayer for Zion and Jerusalem's restoration. Keep the scene restrained and historically plausible, with no dramatic temple ceremony or anachronistic monumental architecture. Authentic Israelite garments, stone walls, wooden tools, natural morning light. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Why Do You Boast in Mischief?
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an influential ancient Near Eastern man stands in a prosperous courtyard, dressed in fine but plausible garments and surrounded by goods that signal his power. He smiles while speaking with an associate, yet his gestures reveal that his confidence is built on deceit and harmful plans. Nearby, a truthful witness quietly tells an elder about the man's conduct. The contrast between polished appearance and destructive speech is the central visual theme: the wealthy man uses his tongue as a sharp instrument to harm others, choosing falsehood over truth because he values wrongdoing. Doeg the Edomite may be suggested by an attendant in foreign regional clothing, connecting the psalm's heading with the account in 1 Samuel, but do not depict a specific massacre or graphic act of violence. A small olive tree grows beside the courtyard wall, creating a visual contrast with the man's unstable moral foundation. Ancient Near Eastern garments, clay vessels, stone architecture, and natural sunlight. No modern luxury items, readable text, or graphic violence.

title: I Am Like a Green Olive Tree in the House of God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a healthy olive tree grows in the courtyard of an ancient Israelite sanctuary, its thick trunk rooted in firm soil and its branches full of green leaves. David stands beside it, one hand resting gently on the trunk as he reflects on the contrast between trusting in riches and oppression and trusting in God's steadfast love. In the background, several worshippers gather peacefully, and one elder listens as David offers thanksgiving for God's faithful works. Farther away, the grand courtyard of a powerful but dishonest man is deserted, with neglected goods and closed doors, suggesting the passing nature of confidence based on wealth. The olive tree should not look magical; its healthy appearance comes from realistic roots, water, and care. The scene expresses patient trust, praise before the faithful, and hope in God's name forever. Use historically plausible sanctuary architecture, woven clothing, stone paving, pottery, and natural afternoon light. No modern gardening equipment, captions, or fantasy effects.
